stem: A client prescribed rivaroxaban 20 mg once daily for treatment of DVT says, ‘I usually take it before breakfast on an empty stomach.’ Which response by the nurse is best?

options.A: Take the 20 mg dose with food at approximately the same time each day because food improves absorption of this dose
options.B: Continue taking the 20 mg dose fasting because food substantially reduces rivaroxaban absorption
options.C: All rivaroxaban strengths must be taken fasting, so avoid meals for several hours after every dose
options.D: The relationship to food is unimportant for every rivaroxaban dose and indication

rationale: Current rivaroxaban labeling specifies that 15 mg and 20 mg tablets should be taken with food. For DVT/PE treatment, the 20 mg once-daily maintenance dose is taken with food at approximately the same time each day. Food increases exposure to the 20 mg dose; lower strengths such as 10 mg may be taken with or without food depending on the indication.
educational_objective: Teach the dose-specific food requirement for rivaroxaban 20 mg without incorrectly applying it to every rivaroxaban strength.
source_locator: Sections 2.1 and 12.3: DVT/PE treatment 20 mg once daily with food; 15 mg and 20 mg tablets should be taken with food; food increases 20 mg bioavailability
source_claim_supported: Rivaroxaban 20 mg requires administration with food for appropriate exposure; food requirements differ by dose.
blueprint_source_organization: National Council of State Boards of Nursing
blueprint_locator: Pharmacological and Parenteral Therapies — medication administration and client education
blueprint_topic: Pharmacological and Parenteral Therapies — rivaroxaban administration
correction_summary: Specified a 20 mg DVT-treatment dose and converted the source definition into applied client teaching. Explicitly avoided the false rule that every rivaroxaban strength requires food.
audit_reviewer: OpenAI GPT-5.6 Sol — Rule 1 clinical audit + adversarial second pass

audit_findings.source_audit: Current DailyMed rivaroxaban dosage and pharmacokinetic sections verified.
audit_findings.claim_by_claim: 20 mg with-food requirement and dose-dependent food effect are label-supported.
audit_findings.choice_C: Incorrect; lower strengths may be taken with or without food.
audit_findings.choice_D: Incorrect; food materially affects 15/20 mg administration.
audit_findings.ambiguity_second_answer: Only A matches the specified 20 mg DVT regimen.
audit_findings.independent_adversarial_second_pass: Checked AF vs DVT indications, 10 mg exception and formulation/feeding-tube issues; no unresolved conflict.
